evidence_basis: The production owner audited actual REQUEST parameters, the complete reply, downstream deadline consumers and the selected source inverse. Ops consumed that source-ready metadata and the independent Test owner's request audit, source review and cost record. Private business source, requests, answers and oracles remain with their owners.
scope: One existing readiness method and a pure Instant predicate, plus a separate independently prepared Test source task.

production_request.selected_unit: The requested complete method replacement and pure Instant helper; zero owner executable-code corrections. This is not raw whole-file byte adoption or an entire-component adoption rate.
production_request.guidance: The owner first diagnosed the two original budgets, identified four real call sites and supplied the precise contract. This is a strongly guided narrow implementation, not autonomous fault discovery.
contract: Transport and its preceding guard retain the original I/O deadline.
The observation remains within that original I/O deadline and cannot be in the future.
Post-receive join, lifecycle, capability and source checks use the original enclosing-scope deadline.
Final original-scope and writer-head checks remain; no replacement deadline or refreshed now-plus-timeout is introduced.

independent_test_request.independence: The source oracle was frozen before the model task; the Test author did not read the production owner's new candidate or model answer. No private oracle was included in the request.
owner_corrections: Add two missing nominal JUnit Assertions imports.
Consolidate two isolated failure methods so six generated methods become five selected methods, retaining all ten behavior assertions.
independent_test_request.selected_scope: Five pure Instant DATA methods with ten assertions; no collector instance, real clock, files, Native query or private issuer.
independent_test_request.qualification_at_this_cut: SOURCE_READY_NOT_EXECUTED; no collector join, lifecycle, permission or whole-operation integration result.

cost.boundary: HTTP durations are request costs. Preparation, source investigation, coordination and review can overlap them;23.351091 seconds is not total repair time. The two different roles are not a controlled performance comparison.

opencode.daily_maintenance: Existing same-day success cache reused; no new version command for this publication.

publication.historical_cutoffs: The two source cutoffs remain unchanged. Later compile, behavior, formal and runtime receipts must append separately.
